theme: Chance baseline for cross-script graphic resemblance
question: How often do 42 Tamil Nadu base drawings match a declared Indus subset and two separate control inventories under the same shape descriptor?
outcome: R1 segment/loop equality matched 30/42 Tamil Nadu bases to 36 readable Indus cells, 24/42 to 20 Ogham letters and 32/42 to 32 Tifinagh letters. R3 complete descriptors matched 4/42, 1/42 and 10/42. Independent agent passes agreed on complete vectors for 12/19 comparable drawings. Frozen bytes and exact computation were rerun; the null is Synthetic descriptor resampling.
challenge: Only the eight-page 2025 brochure was recovered; its 60% and >90% claims lack reproducible denominators/rules in that witness. Six sampled Indus cells were excluded and 22 retained uncertainty. Controls differ in complexity and use modern representative glyphs. The empirical null cannot generate unseen descriptor classes or new geometric drawings.
remedy: Preserve source coordinates, failed requests and primary/independent coding. Declare rules before outcomes; report size-matched coverage, complexity strata, exact collision formulas and simulation intervals. Keep raw charts, rows and query matches local. Treat measured rates as pilot descriptors and acquire the complete method, improved drawings, trained human coding and held-out geometric-null validation before a transmission test.
retry_when: The full 2025 monograph and matching table, improved central glyph drawings, trained-human agreement, balanced multi-family controls or a geometrically validated null becomes available. Preserve this endpoint; register new coding or rules separately.
